+/*
+ * @test
+ * @bug 8394753
+ * @summary Ensure that `getDisplayCountry` does not emit CLDR test data for
+ *      regions "XA" and "XB".
+ * @run junit PseudoDataRegionTest
+ */
+
+import java.util.Locale;
+
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
+import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
+
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
+
+public class PseudoDataRegionTest {
+
+    @ValueSource(strings = {"XA", "XB"})
+    @ParameterizedTest
+    void getDisplayCountryTest(String region) {
+        // Prior to the fix in 8394753, "XA/XB" would emit CLDR test data for many locales.
+        assertEquals(region, Locale.of("en", region).getDisplayCountry(Locale.ENGLISH));
+    }
+}
